hook: A doctor's examination room full of things to find: tap each object in the picture, then give it its article.
intro: A picture hunt instead of a deck: one doctor's examination room with 32 things to find in it, every one a noun you meet when you go to the doctor's — die Untersuchungsliege, das Stethoskop, der Rollstuhl, das Blutdruckmessgerät on the wall. The prompt asks Wo ist die Spritze? and you tap it in the picture. Each find shows its label, coloured by its gender, then leaves a small tick in that colour, so you can see what you have already found. Once you have passed a run, the hunt turns harder: the prompt hides the article (Wo ist ___ Spritze?), and after the find you choose der, die or das yourself. A tap on bare wall costs nothing; a tap on the wrong object tells you what you hit and you keep looking, and after three misses the right one is shown. No object is asked twice in the same run.
tips[0].title: Compounds in the surgery: the last part decides
tips[0].text: Medical words are long, but only the last part decides the article. Untersuchung + Liege: die Liege, so die Untersuchungsliege. Medizin + Schrank: der Schrank, so der Medizinschrank. Blutdruck + Messgerät: das Gerät, so das Blutdruckmessgerät.
tips[0].check.why: The last part is der Spender, so the whole word is der Seifenspender.
tips[1].title: Instruments in -skop are neuter
tips[1].text: Viewing instruments ending in -skop are always das: das Stethoskop, das Mikroskop. Two more neuter families in this room: words built on das Gerät (das Blutdruckmessgerät) and on das Mittel (das Desinfektionsmittel).
tips[1].check.why: Instruments in -skop are neuter: das Stethoskop, das Mikroskop, das Teleskop.
tips[2].title: Ends in -e? Guess die
tips[2].text: Most nouns ending in -e are feminine, and this room is full of them: die Spritze, die Krücke, die Waage, die Mullbinde, die Arzttasche. When you find one, say it aloud with die; the red label shows you were right.
tips[2].check.why: Waage ends in -e, and like most nouns in -e it is feminine: die Waage.
remember[0]: The last part of a compound sets the article: der Medizinschrank, die Untersuchungsliege, das Blutdruckmessgerät.
remember[1]: -skop instruments are das: das Stethoskop, das Mikroskop.
remember[2]: Nouns in -e are mostly die: die Spritze, die Krücke, die Waage.
